sentences.en: In May 2007, an artist living in Chicago moved into a new place.
sentences.zh: 2007 年 5 月，一位住在芝加哥的艺术家搬进了一个新住处。

sentences.en: It was a small room with white walls.
sentences.zh: 那是一个有着白墙的小房间。

sentences.en: The interior design was minimaliSt.
sentences.zh: 室内设计走的是极简主义风格。

sentences.en: There was a bed, a desk, a computer, a lamp, and a paintball gun.
sentences.zh: 房间里有一张床、一张书桌、一台电脑、一盏灯，还有一把彩弹枪。

sentences.en: Affixed to the gun was a webcam.
sentences.zh: 枪上安装了一个网络摄像头。

sentences.en: It live-streamed the room to the internet.
sentences.zh: 它将房间的画面实时直播到了互联网上。

sentences.en: Anyone could look in, and anyone could take control of the gun, aim, and fire.
sentences.zh: 任何人都可以观看，也可以控制这把枪进行瞄准和射击。

sentences.en: At all hours of the day and night, the paintball gun would spring to life
sentences.zh: 无论白天还是黑夜，这把彩弹枪随时都会启动，

sentences.en: and begin shooting yellow pellets into the room.
sentences.zh: 开始向房间内发射黄色彩弹。

sentences.en: Some hit the walls or the furniture.
sentences.zh: 有些打在了墙上或家具上。

sentences.en: Some hit the artiSt.
sentences.zh: 有些则打在了艺术家身上。

sentences.en: I was shot at 70,000 times, and I received 80 million hits on the internet from 128 countries.
sentences.zh: 我被击中了 7 万次，在互联网上收到了来自 128 个国家的 8000 万次点击。

sentences.en: Wafa Bilal spent one whole month in the room, targeted tens of thousands of times by random strangers around the world.
sentences.zh: Wafa Bilal 在那个房间里待了整整一个月，被世界各地素不相识的陌生人瞄准了数万次。

sentences.en: Why would he choose to do this?
sentences.zh: 他为什么要选择这样做呢？

sentences.en: Wafa was born and raised in Iraq.
sentences.zh: Wafa 在伊拉克出生长大。

sentences.en: He came to the U.S.

sentences.en: in the early 90s.

sentences.en: One is a comfort zone of the United States, and the other one is the conflict zone in Iraq, where my family, friends, live.
sentences.zh: 2004 年，Wafa 说他的一个兄弟在空袭中丧生。

sentences.en: In 2004, Wafa says one of his brothers was killed in an airstrike.
sentences.zh: 我的一个兄弟 Haji，死于空对地导弹的袭击。

sentences.en: One of my brothers, Haji, was killed in an air-to-ground missile.
sentences.zh: 我当时不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: And I didn't know what to do.

sentences.en: Wafa is a performance artist, and he wanted to engage others in the conversation that was running through his mind.
sentences.zh: 在他兄弟去世三年后，他产生了一个想法。

sentences.zh: 2007 年 1 月，我正在看电视，看到了一段对一名美国士兵的采访。

sentences.en: In January of 2007, I was watching TV, and I was watching an interview with an American soldier.

sentences.zh: 我感到非常震惊，这名士兵在身体和情感上与伊拉克地面上发生的事情完全脱节了。

sentences.en: I was shocked how the soldier completely disconnected physically and emotionally from what happened on the ground in Iraq.

sentences.en: My mother received the scholarship from Peru, and my father did not receive a scholarship, but nonetheless came to Washington State from Pakistan.
sentences.zh: 于是，他们从利马和拉合尔这两座大城市，来到了普尔曼这个安静的小镇，并在那里坠入爱河。

sentences.en: So, they traveled from Lima and Lahore, these two massive cities, to the sleepy town of Pullman, where they fell in love.
sentences.zh: 每当想起我的父母，我认为他们最大的共同点就是在美国的那种异乡感。

sentences.en: When I think about my parents, I think the biggest thing that they had in common was their sense of foreignness in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在一个他们都不了解的地方，他们从彼此身上获得了一些安慰。

sentences.en: They sort of took comfort in each other in a place that neither of them understood.
sentences.zh: 但随着他们对美国越来越适应，

sentences.en: But as they grew more comfortable with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们对彼此却越来越不适应。

sentences.en: and were acclimated to it, they grew less comfortable with each other.
sentences.zh: 他们离婚了，在我八岁时开始分居，直到我 12 岁才正式结束，那是一段漫长而痛苦的分手，而我是他们的独生子。

sentences.en: And they divorced, they started splitting up when I was eight, but didn't finish until I was 12, and theirs was a long and acrimonious split, and I am their only child.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的童年大部分时间都在他们两家之间来回奔波，感觉就像是在平行宇宙之间穿梭，

sentences.en: And so, a lot of my childhood was spent kind of bouncing around between their houses, and it really felt like I was bouncing between parallel universes,
sentences.zh: 因为他们的优先事项、价值观和恐惧，真的和他们的家乡一样遥远。

sentences.en: because their priorities and values and fears are really as far apart as their hometowns.
sentences.zh: 所以，作为一个小孩，我经常感到困惑。

sentences.en: So, I would often feel confused, you know, as a small child.
sentences.zh: 和妈妈在一起时，我会试着找出支配她内心和思想的规则，并让这些规则对我自己也适用。

sentences.en: I would try to, when I was with my mom, figure out the rules that governed her heart and mind and make them true for myself.
sentences.zh: 但当我去了爸爸家，同样的规则就不管用了。

sentences.en: But then, when I would go to my dad's house, those same rules would stop working.
sentences.zh: 这真的很让人困惑，我想对我们三个人来说，感觉就像我必须在父母之间做出选择，放弃真正了解另一方。

sentences.en: And it was just very confusing, and it felt, I think, to all three of us, like I would really have to choose one of my parents and give up on really knowing the other.
sentences.zh: 但我知道，为了我们所有人，我必须尝试。

sentences.en: But I knew that I had to try, for all of our sake.
sentences.zh: 于是我做了，我不断努力，最终做得更好，学会了调整自己去适应父母不同的频率。

sentences.en: So, I did, and I kind of kept working at it, and eventually got better and learned to tune myself to my parents' different frequencies.
sentences.zh: 这在某种程度上拯救了儿时的我。

sentences.en: And that kind of saved me as a kid.

sentences.en: I think empathy saved me.

sentences.en: Not because it was easy, it was work.
sentences.zh: 我一直把父母的离婚看作是我的“同理心健身房”，它迫使我锻炼自己关心和理解他人的能力。

sentences.en: I always think of my parents' divorce as an empathy gym for me that forced me to work out my ability to care about and understand other people.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，你将其描述为“同理心健身房”。

sentences.en: And you, as you've said, described this as an empathy gym.
sentences.zh: 有没有什么时候你没能对他们表现出同理心？

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我必须想象，作为一个小孩，在很多方面要理解正在发生的事情一定非常困难，

sentences.en: I mean, I must imagine that as a small child, it must have been very difficult in many ways to comprehend what was happening

sentences.en: I think as a child, it's very easy to focus on your own perspective and what you're going through and to blame others, especially adults.

sentences.zh: 他们发现，如果人们只是阅读观点，他们更有可能将对方非人化，
